pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

* The owl is tied to one of the foundational books on superintelligence.
* Elon has been discussing the risks and future of SI for years.
* Tesla is now using an owl as part of its official visual presentation.
* $OWL already has the exact mascot that ties this narrative together.

If the Superintelligence narrative takes off and people start connecting these references, discovering this coin at its current valuation could be an absolute steal.

This could be one of those plays people wish they had spotted earlier.

$OWL knows something.
